Execute atomic concept SQL for all concepts matching a source and type

Source: R/atomic_concepts.R
run_atomic_concepts_unified.Rd

Reads the concept config CSV, builds CREATE TABLE SQL for each concept, writes it to sql_out_dir, and executes it against con.

Usage

run_atomic_concepts_unified(
  con = NULL,
  concept_config_path,
  src_name,
  schema_names,
  typ = NULL,
  sql_out_dir,
  user_concepts = NULL,
  concept_name = NULL,
  dry_run = FALSE,
  engine = c("postgres", "duckdb"),
  rm_duplicates = TRUE
)

Arguments

con

DBI connection. Required unless dry_run = TRUE. Its dialect must match engine.

concept_config_path

Path to rendehr_concepts_config.csv or rendehr_duration_concepts_config.csv.

src_name

Source name (e.g. "mimic_iv_demo").

schema_names

List from src_schema_names().

typ

Concept type filter: "ts", "dur", or NULL for all.

sql_out_dir

Directory to write generated SQL files.

user_concepts

Optional path to a supplemental concept CSV. A concept defined here (same source + concept_name) replaces all package rows for that concept with all of its rows in this file; other package concepts are kept unchanged. Lets users add or redefine concepts without editing package files. An error if the file does not exist.

concept_name

Optional character vector to restrict execution to specific concept name(s), instead of every concept matching src_name/ typ. Useful while iterating on one concept without rebuilding the rest.

dry_run

If TRUE, build (and still write to sql_out_dir) the SQL for each matching concept without executing it. con is not required in this mode. Default FALSE.

engine

SQL dialect to generate: "postgres" (default) or "duckdb". Only affects the small handful of clauses that differ between the two (currently: the case-insensitive regex match used by rgx_exp_itm concepts). Must match the dialect con actually speaks.

rm_duplicates

Logical. If TRUE (default), remove chart rows that are copies of lab results. A MIMIC chart row (MetaVision or CareVue) flagged required_dedup = TRUE in the concept config is dropped only when one of the concept's extracted lab rows (or an item named in its dedup_cross_reference, as concept:itemid) has the same subject and admission, the same stored value, an exact allowed offset between the original timestamps (MIMIC-IV 0, MIMIC-III 0 or +60 minutes), and the same canonical unit after each row's configured conversion. A blank chart unit is treated as the concept's target unit; any other unresolved unit is kept. An eICU nurse-charted vital (nursecharting) flagged required_dedup = TRUE is dropped when the same concept has a vitalperiodic or vitalaperiodic row for the same unit stay, minute offset and value; the monitor row is kept. In addition, chart rows of a ts concept that agree on all ID columns, minute, value and unit (for example two CareVue items charting the same glucose) are kept once, as the row with the lowest item id; rows with a NULL value and rows from other tables (labs, drugs) are never removed by this rule. FALSE extracts exactly the same rows and removes none. Rules for a concept replaced through user_concepts are disabled, as are cross-concept references to a replaced concept. A cross-concept reference is used only when its owning concept is built successfully in the same call; otherwise the chart copies are retained.

Value

Invisibly returns a named logical vector, one entry per attempted concept, TRUE if its table was built successfully and FALSE if its CREATE TABLE execution failed. Returns invisible(logical(0)) when no concept matches the source/type filter. A failed concept does not stop the remaining concepts from being attempted; the caller is responsible for inspecting the returned vector to detect partial or total failure. When dry_run = TRUE, instead invisibly returns a named character vector of concept_name -> generated SQL text, and nothing is executed.

Details

The configuration is checked with validate_concept_config() before any SQL is built. Its problems are reported in one immediate warning; rows with a "skip" problem (an unknown itm_class, or an empty match_value for a class other than col_itm) are left out and the remaining rows are built. A concept built without some of its rows is reported as OK: <concept> (<n> config row(s) skipped: <reasons>).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
con <- connect_postgres("rendehr", load_credentials("config/config_pass.json"))
run_atomic_concepts_unified(con,
  concept_config_path = system.file("extdata", "rendehr_concepts_config.csv", package = "rendehR"),
  src_name = "mimic_iv_demo", schema_names = src_schema_names("mimic_iv_demo"),
  typ = "ts", sql_out_dir = "sql/generated/mimic_iv_demo/ts", concept_name = "heart_rate")
} # }
